Tabletop
Music Player

Built specifically for Dungeon Masters, this is the music tool your table has been missing. Stop fumbling with playlists mid-session — find exactly the right track in seconds and keep the immersion alive.

Over 100 original tracks composed for D&D — battles, exploration, boss encounters, and more.
Filter by creature type, setting, mood, energy level, musical style, and emotion — simultaneously.
Integrate with your Discord server so your players hear the music live in the voice channel.
Build a live queue on the fly, toggle songs in and out, shuffle, loop, and keep the session flowing.
